definitions.explanation: Something that can be done without much difficulty. A formal, written-style word.

examples.japanese: {容易|ようい}なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容易|ようい}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Solving the problem was not easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{容易|ようい}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Regaining trust once lost is not easy.

notes:
{容易|ようい} is a na-adjective meaning "easy" in a formal register.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {容易|ようい}な + noun
- Adverbial: {容易|ようい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (easily)
- Negative: {容易|ようい}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容易|ようい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}できる→想像する：06060_souzousuru⟧ (easy to imagine)
- {容易|ようい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (easy to obtain)
- {容易|ようい}なこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no easy matter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {容易|ようい} vs. ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ vs. {易|やさ}しい: All mean "easy," but {容易|ようい} is the most formal and appears mainly in written language. ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧ is the neutral, everyday word. {易|やさ}しい is versatile but also means "gentle" or "kind."

USAGE:
{容易|ようい} frequently appears in negative constructions ({容易|ようい}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, {容易|ようい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧). The adverbial form {容易|ようい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is common in writing. Note the homophone ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧ (preparation), which is a different word.
